evidence.quote: Rows increase down; columns right. Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation tied to the identified content found.

COD.rationale: Organization/presentation (O) is not explicitly asserted beyond coordinate listings; therefore COD cannot be formed.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition statement bound to the identified content was found.

C.rationale: The text explicitly identifies content (red) and its attribute as coordinate set for a named current record.

D.rationale: The report separately records origin/status metadata for the same identified content, distinguishing content identification from its representation/origin status.

O.rationale: The report lists coordinate sets (positions) and metadata but does not provide an explicit statement of how the identified content is presented/emerges beyond raw coordinates; coordinates alone do not satisfy O per the reference rules.
